policy: External puzzles remain evaluation references. Do not use them as generation seeds, training examples or production puzzle stock. Dataset-level licenses do not establish rights to every third-party image.

datasets.title: COLUMBUS
datasets.notes: Rule/graph-based generation is the most relevant architectural reference. Icon/text variants overlap and must be grouped by answer. Multiple-choice accuracy is not open-ended solve accuracy. Source code documents scraped phrase inputs and external icons; do not assume downstream training/image rights from MIT alone.

datasets.title: Reasoning Riddles rebus puzzles
datasets.notes: 221 cases with alternate answers and mechanism annotations. Attribution required. Third-party image provenance still needs row review; do not auto-approve source rights or answer validity.

datasets.title: RE-BUS
datasets.notes: Already supported by the strict external benchmark importer. Separate originals from augmentations. Dataset card cautions about commercial use and third-party rights. Preserve existing per-row approval requirements.

datasets.title: REBUS
datasets.notes: 333 original examples across 13 categories. No license in inspected dataset card or GitHub API response. No content import.

datasets.title: Puzzled by Puzzles
datasets.notes: 432 cases, eleven skill types. Paper mentions MIT, but repository API reports no recognized license. Resolve exact data/image grant before import.

datasets.title: PuzzleWorld
datasets.notes: 667 puzzlehunt tasks, not a direct rebus generator corpus. Noncommercial restriction: exclude from commercial training. Paper reports reasoning-trace supervision outperforming answer-only supervision in its solver experiment; this is not evidence that a rebus generator will improve.

datasets.title: RebusBench
datasets.notes: Relevant recent cognitive visual reasoning benchmark. No license in inspected dataset card or GitHub API response; no content import.
